What a plan month looks like.

Requests are tracked in one place, whether they arrive by email, in a meeting or another way.

01

You set the priorities

You choose what we work on within your allowance. We advise on risks, feasibility and dependencies. Critical security issues are escalated and handled urgently.

02

We build, manage and improve

We deliver the agreed work: a website change, a software feature, an automation, an integration, a report or a training session.

03

We test, document and train

Work is tested before it goes live, documented, and explained to the people who will use it.

04

We report and plan ahead

You receive a plain-language summary of what changed and what we recommend next. Growth and Transformation include regular forward planning.

How the plans work

Clear limits.
Clear ownership.

Unused allowances do not roll over. Each month’s allowance expires at the end of that service month.

Need more? You can approve extra scoped work, upgrade your plan, or schedule the request for a future month, subject to that month’s capacity. Nothing extra is charged or started without your approval. A request queued for next month does not create a rollover.

Included technology costs. Hosting and the third-party software and API usage needed for the agreed work are included up to your plan’s allowance. Usage above it is agreed with you before it is spent. Advertising spend and payment-processing fees are not included.

Your accounts. Hosting, domains, databases and provider accounts are held in your name by default. We administer them for you within the plan.

Your work. Custom deliverables you have paid for belong to you, subject to any disclosed third-party licences and pre-existing components.

Cancel any time. There is no minimum term. Anything owed for a month you have paid for, including documentation, training and handover, is still delivered. How a cancellation is billed, and how work in progress is valued, are set out in your service agreement.

Common questions

Simple answers before you start.

Who gets the 30% introductory price?+

Every genuinely new customer on Foundation, Growth or Transformation. It applies to each of your first three billed months. From month four you pay the regular monthly price. Enterprise partnerships are quoted individually and are not automatically discounted.

Can I cancel?+

Yes. There is no fixed three-month minimum. Final billing and how work in progress is valued are set out in your service agreement.

What if I need more than my plan includes?+

You can approve additional scoped work, move to a higher plan or schedule the work for a future month’s allowance.

Do unused allowances carry over?+

No. Monthly allowances expire at the end of each service month.

Are hosting and AI costs included?+

Specified hosting, software and usage allowances are included. Additional or exceptional costs need a clear, agreed arrangement before they are incurred.

Do you train our team?+

Yes. Plans include defined training and documentation for the systems we deliver. Extra sessions after an engagement ends may be quoted separately.

Who owns what you build?+

Paid-for custom deliverables are yours, subject to any clearly disclosed third-party licences and pre-existing components.

Do you take on one-off projects?+

Yes. A defined website, automation or systems build can be quoted as a fixed-scope project and billed in milestones. Most clients choose a monthly plan so the work keeps improving after launch.

Is the Website Builder part of a plan?+

The Website Builder is a self-service software product with its own price, from GHS 36/month. It is separate from our managed plans, where we do the work for you.
